messages:
incident-bot: Pager: METRICS_ALARM metering.token_count_drift triggered in eu-west-1 (severity: high) - see alert: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/1786549876
ingest-sre: seeing token-count delta between emitter and ledger for last ~30m, ~12% higher on emitter side
sasha: confirmed, dashboards show emitter > ledger by ~180k tokens in 30m window. Customer invoices might be impacted if this persists :grimacing:
mike: any recent deploys to emitter or the aggregator? I rolled a small producer patch 45m ago but it was a non-billing change
leah: ingest consumer lag is fine, but I see spike in `emitter.retry_count` starting 00:25. Could be duplicate replays.
ingest-sre: tailing logs from emitter: ```WARN duplicate event id=0x7f9c3 retry=3 topic=usage```
ingsest-sre: (typo) meant ingest-sre: that duplicate pattern correlates with a Kafka partition rebalance at 00:22
sasha: quick customer-impact check: billing overflag triggers fired for ~8 customers in last hour; most are internal test accounts but two are paying customers (acct 34021, 55099)
billing-oncall: I've been paged. I'm running a live reconciliation query against ledger vs emitter for the last two hours now. ETA ~6m
dave: temp mitigation proposal: freeze overage notifications and disable automated overflag webhook to billing-notify while we reconcile. We should avoid sending customer overage emails during noisy window :+1:
mike: ops, can we throttle emitter retries to avoid amplification? I can flip max_retries=1 for emitter group `usage-producer-v2` in-flight
leah: also recommend enabling prefix-KV-dedup in the aggregator for a short window (hotpatch) rather than full restart
billing-oncall: reconciliation quick result: emitter=2,100,412 tokens; ledger=1,917,998 tokens for window 00:00-02:00 UTC -> delta +182,414 tokens
sasha: that delta matches the overflagged customer counts. We should credit affected customers if noisy overflag caused billing alerts
ingsest-sre: putting a short-term Kafka consumer pause on partition 12 to allow manual replaying of suspected duplicates. Command: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --pause --group usage-aggregator --topic usage --partition 12`
mike: hotpatch steps I will run: 1) set emitter max_retries=1 via shepherd API 2) enable de-dup flag on aggregator 3) disable billing webhook. I'll open a gated runbook PR and post status here
sasha: please also add a rollback plan - if de-dup causes data loss, we need to revert in 15m. Keep a short window
billing-oncall: I've stopped automated overflag webhooks. Posting customer comms draft to #customer-ops for approval. Recommend crediting two paying customers pending root cause
dave: after throttling retries, emitter retry_count dropped ~90% in 3m. Delta started shrinking in Grafana
leah: aggregator de-dup enabled, no restarts, warmed cache OK. Running a parity job: `python tools/parity_check.py --from 00:00 --to 02:00 --mode incremental`
billing-oncall: parity job shows remaining delta ~18k tokens now, likely older buffered duplicates. Will schedule backfill reconciliation and credit ledger for affected invoices
sasha: good live mitigation. Next steps: 1) continue parity job until delta <1% 2) issue credits to the two customers 3) open incident ticket with RCA owner assignment (ingest-sre + mike) 4) follow-up postmortem in 48h
mike: PR for hotpatch runbook: https://git.redwood/ops/hotpatch/PR-342 - tagging @leah for de-dup notes
leah: I'll take the RCA for aggregator logic and de-dup gaps
incident-bot: Incident annotated: priority=high, status=mitigating, runbook=https://git.redwood/ops/hotpatch/PR-342, owner=@ingest-sre
sasha: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms and billing credits after final parity pass. If anyone sees new overflags, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
